checks.message: RC21-010 must run after RC21-001 completed, with current_task set to RC21-010 or during an idempotent rerun.
RC21-010 must consume the RC21 local transactional lifecycle authority contract.
RC20 final audit must prove single-user distribution local consumer readiness and keep production readiness false.
RC20 consumer smoke must report local consumer readiness without production readiness.
Catalog must bind RC20 release bundle and local channel evidence without external mirror, active artifact set, or production ring mutation.
Catalog must bind RC20 installer, install, first boot, update, rollback, and support/recovery evidence.
Catalog must bind a coherent RC20 release, target state, support, and rollback identity chain.
Catalog must bind install, update, repair/reinstall, downgrade/rollback, support export, and recovery reference intents.
Catalog must remain local-only, non-executable, non-GA, and must not authorize host mutation, remote dispatch, support upload, or recovery execution.
Every intent must record exact required inputs, audit expectations, and denial reasons.
RC21-010 must not execute lifecycle operations or broaden host, production, remote, signer, object storage, support upload, recovery, or GA authority.
Missing/stale RC20 evidence and forbidden authority attempts must deny before operation intent authority.
RC21-010 outputs must not contain key blocks, private authority paths, auth tokens, signing key file names, raw passwords, raw secrets, or public identity markers.
